diagnostic: 4c follow-up — six dashboard groups by STATION ID (sha1(station)[:16])
fixed_rule: Flag a 6-hourly GWL point at time t for station s if |gwl_t - gwl_{t-6h}| > max(2.5 * MAD_s, 2.0 m), where MAD_s is the station's median absolute deviation of the FULL series (median of |gwl - median(gwl)|). Only flag points where both gwl_t and gwl_{t-6h} are finite.
matching: groups seeded from data/meta/selected_gwl_stations.csv; events/flagged joined and grouped by station_id only
